items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: See, then he enticed Willie and I to make a band up together. That's how we come to make the band up.

ctx.x: Who was your favorite trumpet player in those days? Did you have a favorite? Yeah, I did.

Did you like better than anybody else? Yeah, I certainly did. My favorite trumpet player was Manuel Perez. I went to him to get some lessons, you know, take lessons from him. Well he had his hand full. You see, he couldn't take me, but he recommended Professor Humphrey. That's how I started taking lessons from him. How long did you take lessons from Humphrey? Oh, I guess I'd take lessons from him about a year. See, then he enticed Willie and I to make a band up together. That's how we come to make the band up.
Remember the method book you used?
